_doc: Keyframed animations, usable like any built-in anim (and in layers: walk+salute). loop = cycle length in seconds (0 = play once and hold the last key). held = add breathing/glances while holding. Joints: la ra (arms) ll rl (legs) hd (head) ts (torso) as [x,y,z] radians; x<0 = forward/up, la z<0 / ra z>0 = raised sideways. Also y (height), lean, sq (squash). A key's ease = how the pose arrives at it: smooth (default), linear, back (overshoot), spring.
